title: Open Chiari: an open 3D anatomy model of Chiari malformation type I
description:
Open 3D models and figures of the head and upper neck at the midline, in four conditions: typical anatomy, Chiari malformation type I, Chiari I with a syrinx, and after decompression surgery. They were made for patient education on openchiari.org.

Every shape and measurement is traced to a source in docs/EVIDENCE.md. The measurements are checked automatically (npm run model:check), and independent audits are kept in docs/audits/. In the Simple model, the lowest point of the cerebellar tonsils sits about 1 mm above the McRae line in the typical view and about 12 mm below it in the Chiari I view, as EVIDENCE.md states.

Included: the Simple model (glTF and Blender), the anatomy figures, 3D-printable plaques, the scripts that build and check them, and the source records and audits. A more realistic model in model/realistic/ is still in development and has not passed the site's accuracy checks.

Illustrations, not medical images. Not medical advice. No medical professional has reviewed this work; see the site's accuracy checks.
